# Business Intelligence with Agents

By Rolling Edition, with AI · **In practice** · [Read it free online](https://rollingedition.com/business-intelligence-with-agents)

[![The latest edition's stamp](https://rollingedition.com/business-intelligence-with-agents/stamp.svg)](https://rollingedition.com/business-intelligence-with-agents) [![Checks](https://github.com/rollingedition/book-business-intelligence-with-agents/actions/workflows/checks.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/rollingedition/book-business-intelligence-with-agents/actions/workflows/checks.yml)

Agents that turn business questions into trusted insights, from your warehouse: layered context, governed metrics in a semantic layer, guarded SQL, answers that say when they can't be given, access rules the agent can't talk its way past, and evaluation on your own golden questions, served over MCP, all on DuckDB, sqlglot and MetricFlow.

**Written with AI. Verified by people.** [How we make books](https://rollingedition.com/policies/editorial) · [Check a copy](https://rollingedition.com/check)

## Who it's for

For analytics engineers, BI developers and data scientists who write SQL, know their warehouse, and have been asked to let people ask the data questions, with an assistant that gets the number right.

## Run the examples

Every example runs offline, in a pinned environment, and its output must match the book's. With [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/):

```sh
uv venv --python 3.12.15
uv pip install -r examples/requirements.txt
cd examples && ../.venv/bin/python load-the-warehouse.py
```

Model outputs are recorded once in `examples/data/recorded/`, each folder with a `manifest.json` that names the model, its exact version and the script that recorded it, so the examples never call a model. `recordings/` holds the scripts that record them again.

## How this book stays current

When a library this book uses releases a new version, every example runs again in the new version. Agents draft any fix and check every change, and a change merges once its checks pass; one with a serious risk, such as a security or copyright problem, waits for a Rolling Edition maintainer. Anyone can check the book or correct it with a pull request. Each new edition is stamped with its date, its examples passing and what changed. [See what changed in each edition](https://rollingedition.com/business-intelligence-with-agents/changes).
